snippet.title: Pettson's Inventions 2
snippet.description:
. Out now for iPad and iPhone: http://filimund.us/573512990/youtube
. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=se.filimundus.pi2
. Windows 8 & RT: http://apps.microsoft.com/windows/app/pettsons-inventions-2/f160887c-5d08-4514-8d7c-b6217fa9a4ae

The sequel to the praised Pettson's Inventions. Bigger, better and more fun than ever! 

Help old man Pettson and his cat Findus build their amazing inventions! Which of the objects should be included and where do they fit in the machinery? Drag and drop the parts to their right spot and watch the invention go! As usual a secret waits to be unlocked for those who manages to complete everything. A fun and pedagogic app that teaches logic and stimulates creativity for children of all ages.
